models_evaluated: Custom AI segmentation model for pelvic anatomical structures (ureter, obturator nerve, external iliac artery and vein)

links.outcome: Surgeon sensitivity and specificity in recognizing pelvic structures with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: AI assistance significantly improved surgeons' sensitivity and specificity across all structures (p < .001); 36 surgeons reviewed 640 video snippets.
links.quote: Across all structures, AI assistance led to a significant improvement in sensitivity and specificity among participating surgeons (p < .001).

screen.reason: Empirical study testing the impact of AI assistance on surgeons' anatomical recognition performance in a reader/simulation study of video snippets.
